facts:2026-09-03.window_summary: A worktree dev server failed on a node_modules symlink.

memories.statement: In shop, run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile in each worktree instead of symlinking node_modules from the main checkout, because Turbopack refuses a node_modules outside the project root.
memories.description: The worktree setup script now removes a stale node_modules symlink and installs with pnpm. The same holds for any repo in the dev org that builds with Turbopack.
memories.decision_outcome: Adopted pnpm install per worktree; rejected symlinking node_modules.

evidence.quote: run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile in each worktree instead
evidence.speaker: user

disposition.note: Decided in one session; no other worktree has confirmed the new setup script yet.

memories.statement: Turbopack refuses a node_modules that resolves outside the project root, so a symlinked node_modules breaks the shop dev server in a worktree.
memories.description: The worktree's node_modules was a symlink to the main checkout, and the dev server failed until it was replaced.

evidence.quote: Turbopack says node_modules resolves outside the project root
evidence.speaker: user

preferences:2026-09-03.window_summary: Review comment tone and worktree dependencies.

memories.statement: Phrase code review comments as questions, not directives.
memories.description: Stated directly as a preference for how review feedback is written.

evidence.quote: I prefer review comments phrased as questions, not directives.
evidence.speaker: user

memories.statement: Never symlink node_modules into a shop worktree.
memories.description: Given as a standing rule after the worktree dev server failed on a symlink.

evidence.quote: don't symlink node_modules, turbopack refuses it.
evidence.speaker: user

facts:2026-09-15.window_summary: A billing retry double-charged a customer.

memories.statement: Generating a fresh idempotency key for each billing retry attempt double-charged customers.
memories.description: The approach was tried and reverted because each attempt looked like a new charge to the payment provider.

evidence.quote: we tried generating a fresh key per attempt last month and it double-charged.
evidence.speaker: user

memories.statement: The billing retry path built a new request without the original Idempotency-Key header, so the payment provider treated each retry as a new charge.
memories.description: A customer was charged twice before the retry was fixed to carry the original key.

evidence.quote: builds a new request without the original Idempotency-Key header
evidence.speaker: assistant

preferences:2026-09-15.window_summary: How billing retries handle idempotency keys.

memories.statement: Always reuse the original idempotency key on billing retries.
memories.description: Stated as a team rule after a retry that used a fresh key double-charged a customer.

evidence.quote: always reuse the original idempotency key on billing retries.
evidence.speaker: user
